title: The engine probe is never wired: Setup always says the probe has not answered, so a missing engine is never reported
expected: Codex-only machine: the app names the missing Claude Code and the fix in plain words (criterion 2).
got: Setup's Live passes probes: null and problem: null as literals. No daemon route and no Tauri command carries probe_all; the only Python callers are `athena doctor` and the harness re-export. Every sentence in remedyFor / engineFact / engineLead is unreachable live. The user sees 'the probe has not answered yet' forever.
code_check: grep -rn 'probes:' apps/desktop/src (non-test, non-fixture) -> one hit, setup/index.ts:85 = null. grep probe_all src apps -> no daemon route, no IPC command. Python probe() run with a missing binary returns 'codex-definitely-missing is not on PATH' (so the daemon side works; only the wire is missing).
suggested_acceptance: none; this is the arm's core contract
l2_priority: Fresh store (ATHENA_STORE), claude absent from PATH and codex present: open Setup from the bar and confirm the Engine row text; expect 'has not answered yet' with both pills enabled.

Reaching a running probe would also need the daemon restart (stores/daemon restart), which is behind 'Restart on <engine>', itself only shown when the stored engine differs from the running one.

title: Remedy text is for a developer: 'put `claude` on the PATH', 'sign in once in a terminal', 'probe again', 'version flag'
expected: Plain words: what to install, where to get it, how to check again (criterion 2, 5; senior bar: no terminal).

title: First launch routes around the Setup letter entirely: onboarded is written before Main ever shows
expected: Her first screen in Main is the place that checks her engine, per J1 'the engine she will use is named and found'.
got: 'Open your first app' dispatches onboard, which sets settings.onboarded=true; Rust then shows Main on the Browser module. Setup's mode is derived from onboarded, so the onboarding letter (with its engine passage and 'Open the first app' field) is never what she sees; she gets Settings only if she finds the Setup tab. Net: the engine check lives in a place the first-run path never passes through, and the welcome button says 'Open your first app' but opens an empty Browser with a registration field, not an app.
code_check: Trace: Welcome button -> actions.open -> machine 'open' effect onboard -> setOnboarded(true) -> store.rs notify -> after_onboarded raise(main). selectSetup mode = onboarded && !reopened ? 'settings' : 'onboarding' -> 'settings'. Only reopened=true (Show the welcome again) yields the letter.
l2_priority: Fresh store: press Open your first app; record which module Main lands on and whether any text mentions the engine. Env: normal launch, no ATHENA_START_URL.

title: When the engine is missing the failure arrives as 'The turn stopped: engine_error FileNotFoundError ... [WinError 2]' after she typed a request
expected: A missing engine is explained before a turn, or at least in her words at the turn.
got: The daemon starts regardless of engine presence (no engine check in serve; the Rust 'engine_unavailable' ready-line reason is only parsed). A turn then runs the transport, OSError is caught, and the reason is fixed engine_error with detail ': '. The Talk tab prints engine_error and the raw detail; the tape prints 'stopped' with 'engine_error: ...'. Also daemon-not-ready shows as 'unknown_ref: the daemon is not ready'. Error codes are her explicit pet peeve. TransportError subclasses OSError (transports.py:38) so it is caught and ends as engine_error, as designed.
code_check: grep engine_unavailable src/athena -> 0 hits in Python; Rust test only parses it. ERROR_REASONS (contracts/harness.py:119-135) contains engine_error but nothing engine-specific.
l2_priority: claude absent from PATH: send one message in Talk; capture the exact error text shown.
